```lua
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

		gui.Enabled = false
```

The script builds the whole menu in code, so there is nothing to set up in Studio. Each button is tweened from off-screen with a 0.2 second stagger and a Back easing for a springy slide-in. Play fades the backdrop and disables the GUI, while Shop and Settings reuse one shared panel.

**Plan**
- Create a pause overlay with Resume and a toggle key (P) plus a small Pause button on screen.
- When opened, tween a BlurEffect in Lighting up and tween the "Music" SoundGroup volume down.
- When closed, tween both back to their original values; tag any Sound with "Music" to route it through the group.

```lua
--!strict
-- LocalScript (StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/HorrorPauseMenu)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local FADE = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local PAUSED_VOLUME_SCALE = 0.25
local BLUR_SIZE = 24

local function make(className: string, props: {[string]: any}, parent: Instance?): any
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for key, value in props do
		(inst :: any)[key] = value
	end
	inst.Parent = parent
	return inst
end

local musicGroup = SoundService:FindFirstChild("Music")
if not musicGroup or not musicGroup:IsA("SoundGroup") then
	musicGroup = make("SoundGroup", {Name = "Music", Volume = 1}, SoundService)
end
local music = musicGroup :: SoundGroup
local normalVolume = music.Volume

local function routeSound(inst: Instance)
	if inst:IsA("Sound") then
		inst.SoundGroup = music
	end
end
for _, inst in CollectionService:GetTagged("Music") do
	routeSound(inst)
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Music"):Connect(routeSound)

local blur = make("BlurEffect", {Name = "PauseBlur", Size = 0}, Lighting)

local gui = make("ScreenGui", {Name = "PauseMenu", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true}, playerGui)
local overlay = make("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, gui)
make("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.15), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.25), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "PAUSED", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 30, 30), Font = Enum.Font.Creepster, TextScaled = true,
}, overlay)
local resume = make("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.08), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.5), Text = "Resume",
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
}, overlay)
make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)}, resume)
local pauseButton = make("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 34), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12), Text = "Pause (P)",
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
	TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14,
}, gui)

local isOpen = false
local function setOpen(open: boolean)
	if open == isOpen then
		return
	end
	isOpen = open
	if open then
		normalVolume = music.Volume
		overlay.Visible = true
	end
	TweenService:Create(blur, FADE, {Size = open and BLUR_SIZE or 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(music, FADE, {Volume = open and normalVolume * PAUSED_VOLUME_SCALE or normalVolume}):Play()
	local fade = TweenService:Create(overlay, FADE, {BackgroundTransparency = open and 0.45 or 1})
	fade:Play()
	if not open then
		fade.Completed:Once(function()
			if not isOpen then
				overlay.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

resume.Activated:Connect(function()
	setOpen(false)
end)
pauseButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setOpen(not isOpen)
end)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
	if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		setOpen(not isOpen)
	end
end)
```

The menu opens with P or the on-screen button, because Roblox reserves Escape for its own menu. Opening tweens a BlurEffect to 24 and drops the Music SoundGroup to 25% of its volume, and closing restores both. Any Sound you tag "Music" in CollectionService is routed through that group automatically.

**Plan**
- One dual-context source: the server half owns the DataStore (pcall plus retries) and exposes a RemoteFunction to load and a RemoteEvent to save.
- The server validates every saved value (type, range, integer quality) and rate-limits saves per player.
- The client half builds the settings UI with two draggable sliders and a quality stepper, applies the values live, and sends them on release.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/SettingsSystem). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript at StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/SettingsSystemClient (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
type Settings = {fov: number, music: number, quality: number}
local DEFAULTS: Settings = {fov = 70, music = 0.5, quality = 5}
if RunService:IsServer() then
	local store = game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("PlayerSettings_v1")
	local loadFn = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	loadFn.Name = "LoadSettings"
	local saveEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	saveEvent.Name = "SaveSettings"
	loadFn.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	saveEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	local cache: {[number]: Settings} = {}
	local lastSave: {[number]: number} = {}
	local function withRetry(fn: () -> any): (boolean, any)
		for attempt = 1, 4 do
			local ok, result = pcall(fn)
			if ok then
				return true, result
			end
			task.wait(attempt * 1.5)
		end
		return false, nil
	end
	loadFn.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player): Settings
		if cache[player.UserId] then
			return cache[player.UserId]
		end
		local ok, data = withRetry(function()
			return store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId))
		end)
		local result: Settings = table.clone(DEFAULTS)
		if ok and type(data) == "table" then
			result.fov = math.clamp(tonumber(data.fov) or DEFAULTS.fov, 40, 120)
			result.music = math.clamp(tonumber(data.music) or DEFAULTS.music, 0, 1)
			result.quality = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(data.quality) or DEFAULTS.quality), 1, 10)
		end
		cache[player.UserId] = result
		return result
	end
	saveEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, fov: unknown, music: unknown, quality: unknown)
		if type(fov) ~= "number" or type(music) ~= "number" or type(quality) ~= "number" then
			return
		end
		if fov ~= fov or music ~= music or fov < 40 or fov > 120 or music < 0 or music > 1 then
			return
		end
		if quality < 1 or quality > 10 or quality % 1 ~= 0 or os.clock() - (lastSave[player.UserId] or 0) < 2 then
			return
		end
		lastSave[player.UserId] = os.clock()
		local settings: Settings = {fov = fov, music = music, quality = quality}
		cache[player.UserId] = settings
		withRetry(function()
			store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), settings)
			return true
		end)
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		cache[player.UserId], lastSave[player.UserId] = nil, nil
	end)
else
	local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local loadFn = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("LoadSettings") :: RemoteFunction
	local saveEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SaveSettings") :: RemoteEvent
	local current: Settings = loadFn:InvokeServer()
	local function make(className: string, props: {[string]: any}, parent: Instance?): any
		local inst = Instance.new(className)
		for key, value in props do
			(inst :: any)[key] = value
		end
		inst.Parent = parent
		return inst
	end
	local function isPointer(input: InputObject): boolean
		return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	end
	local function save()
		saveEvent:FireServer(current.fov, current.music, current.quality)
	end
	local function apply()
		local camera, group = workspace.CurrentCamera, SoundService:FindFirstChild("Music")
		if camera then camera.FieldOfView = current.fov end
		if group and group:IsA("SoundGroup") then group.Volume = current.music end
		pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = current.quality end)
	end
	apply()
	local gui = make("ScreenGui", {Name = "SettingsMenu", ResetOnSpawn = false, Enabled = false}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
	local frame = make("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 230), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 44)}, gui)
	local function addSlider(label: string, y: number, minV: number, maxV: number, value: number, onChange: (number) -> ())
		make("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 22), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, y), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = label,
			TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, frame)
		local track = make("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 10), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, y + 32),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 90)}, frame)
		local fill = make("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale((value - minV) / (maxV - minV), 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 160, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0}, track)
		local dragging = false
		local function setFromX(x: number)
			local alpha = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
			fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
			onChange(minV + (maxV - minV) * alpha)
		end
		track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			if isPointer(input) then
				dragging = true
				setFromX(input.Position.X)
			end
		end)
		UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or isPointer(input)) then
				setFromX(input.Position.X)
			end
		end)
		UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			if dragging and isPointer(input) then
				dragging = false
				save()
			end
		end)
	end
	addSlider("Field of View", 15, 40, 120, current.fov, function(v: number)
		current.fov = math.floor(v + 0.5)
		apply()
	end)
	addSlider("Music Volume", 85, 0, 1, current.music, function(v: number)
		current.music = math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		apply()
	end)
	local qualityButton = make("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 165),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 65, 80), TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 16, Text = "Graphics Quality: " .. current.quality}, frame)
	qualityButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		current.quality = current.quality % 10 + 1
		qualityButton.Text = "Graphics Quality: " .. current.quality
		apply()
		save()
	end)
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
		if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.M then
			gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled
		end
	end)
end
```

The same file runs in two places: as a Script on the server it handles the DataStore and validation, and as a LocalScript on the client it builds the menu. The server clamps FOV to 40–120, music to 0–1 and quality to integers 1–10, rejects NaN, and allows one save per player every 2 seconds. Press M to open the menu, drag the sliders to change settings live, and the values are saved when you release.

The script runs from ReplicatedFirst so it appears before the game finishes loading. PreloadAsync reports each asset through its callback, which drives the percentage and bar tween. When loading ends, everything fades out and the GUI is destroyed.

**Plan**
- One dual-context source: the server creates the Red and Blue teams and a RemoteFunction that validates every join request.
- The server refuses a join when the target team would end up larger than the other team, and rate-limits requests.
- The client builds two team cards that show live player counts and call the server when clicked, showing the result message.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/TeamSelect). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript at StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/TeamSelectClient (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local TEAM_NAMES = {"Red", "Blue"}

local function countTeam(team: Team): number
	local count = 0
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if p.Team == team then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local colors = {Red = BrickColor.new("Bright red"), Blue = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")}
	for _, name in TEAM_NAMES do
		if not Teams:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local team = Instance.new("Team")
			team.Name = name
			team.TeamColor = colors[name]
			team.AutoAssignable = false
			team.Parent = Teams
		end
	end

	local joinFn = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	joinFn.Name = "JoinTeam"
	joinFn.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	local lastRequest: {[number]: number} = {}

	joinFn.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, teamName: unknown): (boolean, string)
		if type(teamName) ~= "string" or not table.find(TEAM_NAMES, teamName) then
			return false, "Invalid team"
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lastRequest[player.UserId] or 0) < 1 then
			return false, "Slow down"
		end
		lastRequest[player.UserId] = now
		local target = Teams:FindFirstChild(teamName) :: Team?
		local otherName = if teamName == "Red" then "Blue" else "Red"
		local other = Teams:FindFirstChild(otherName) :: Team?
		if not target or not other then
			return false, "Teams unavailable"
		end
		if player.Team == target then
			return false, "Already on this team"
		end
		local targetCount = countTeam(target)
		local otherCount = countTeam(other)
		if player.Team == other then
			otherCount -= 1
		end
		if targetCount > otherCount then
			return false, teamName .. " has more players. Join the other team."
		end
		player.Team = target
		player.Neutral = false
		return true, "Joined " .. teamName
	end

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		lastRequest[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
else
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local joinFn = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("JoinTeam") :: RemoteFunction

	local function make(className: string, props: {[string]: any}, parent: Instance?): any
		local inst = Instance.new(className)
		for key, value in props do
			(inst :: any)[key] = value
		end
		inst.Parent = parent
		return inst
	end

	local gui = make("ScreenGui", {Name = "TeamSelect", ResetOnSpawn = false}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
	local message = make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.06), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.78), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "Choose your team", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
	}, gui)
	local countLabels: {[string]: TextLabel} = {}
	local cardColors = {Red = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50), Blue = Color3.fromRGB(50, 100, 220)}

	for index, name in TEAM_NAMES do
		local card = make("TextButton", {
			Name = name, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.4), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.2 + (index - 1) * 0.35, 0.3),
```

```lua
	if busy then

		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 36, 48),
	}, dim)
	make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)}, box)
	make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = title, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 24,
	}, box)
	make("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 70), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = message, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 18,
		TextWrapped = true, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
	}, box)
	local yes = make("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 44), Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, -62), Text = "Yes"}, box)
	local no = make("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 44), Position = UDim2.new(1, -175, 1, -62), Text = "No"}, box)
	styleButton(yes, Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 67))
	styleButton(no, Color3.fromRGB(190, 60, 60))

	box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 160)
	TweenService:Create(box, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(380, 200)}):Play()

	local caller = coroutine.running()
	local answered = false
	local function answer(value: boolean)
		if answered then
			return
		end
		answered = true
		task.spawn(caller, value)
	end
	local yesConn = yes.Activated:Connect(function()
		answer(true)
	end)
	local noConn = no.Activated:Connect(function()
		answer(false)
	end)

	local result: boolean = coroutine.yield()
	yesConn:Disconnect()
	noConn:Disconnect()
	gui:Destroy()
	busy = false
	local nextThread = table.remove(waiting, 1)
	if nextThread then
		task.spawn(nextThread)
	end
	return result
end

return ConfirmPrompt
```

Calling `ConfirmPrompt.Prompt("Delete", "Are you sure?")` suspends the caller's thread and resumes it with true or false when a button is clicked. A simple queue holds additional callers until the current dialog is destroyed, so prompts never overlap. The module asserts it is running on the client because it creates GUI in PlayerGui.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/StaminaSystem). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript at StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/StaminaClient (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local MAX_STAMINA = 100
local WALK_SPEED = 16
local SPRINT_SPEED = 26

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local sprintEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	sprintEvent.Name = "SprintState"
	sprintEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

	local DRAIN, REGEN, REGEN_DELAY, MIN_TO_START = 20, 15, 1, 15
	type State = {stamina: number, wantsSprint: boolean, sprinting: boolean, lastUse: number, lastRequest: number}
	local states: {[Player]: State} = {}

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		states[player] = {stamina = MAX_STAMINA, wantsSprint = false, sprinting = false, lastUse = 0, lastRequest = 0}
		player:SetAttribute("Stamina", MAX_STAMINA)
		player:SetAttribute("Sprinting", false)
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		states[player] = nil
	end)

	sprintEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, held: unknown)
		local state = states[player]
		if not state or type(held) ~= "boolean" then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - state.lastRequest < 0.1 then
			return
		end
		state.lastRequest = now
		state.wantsSprint = held
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		for player, state in states do
			local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local moving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
				if state.wantsSprint and moving and (state.sprinting or state.stamina >= MIN_TO_START) and state.stamina > 0 then
					state.sprinting = true
					state.stamina = math.max(0, state.stamina - DRAIN * dt)
					state.lastUse = os.clock()
				else
					state.sprinting = false
					if os.clock() - state.lastUse >= REGEN_DELAY then
						state.stamina = math.min(MAX_STAMINA, state.stamina + REGEN * dt)
					end
				end
				humanoid.WalkSpeed = if state.sprinting then SPRINT_SPEED else WALK_SPEED
				local rounded = math.floor(state.stamina + 0.5)
				if player:GetAttribute("Stamina") ~= rounded then
					player:SetAttribute("Stamina", rounded)
				end
				if player:GetAttribute("Sprinting") ~= state.sprinting then
					player:SetAttribute("Sprinting", state.sprinting)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
else
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local sprintEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SprintState") :: RemoteEvent

	local function make(className: string, props: {[string]: any}, parent: Instance?): any
		local inst = Instance.new(className)
		for key, value in props do
			(inst :: any)[key] = value
		end

		return inst
	end

	local gui = make("ScreenGui", {Name = "StaminaGui", ResetOnSpawn = false}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
	local back = make("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -112), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 12),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, gui)
	make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)}, back)
	local fill = make("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0}, back)
	make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)}, fill)

	local FADE = TweenInfo.new(0.3)
	local shown = false
	local hideToken = 0
	local function setShown(value: boolean)
		if shown == value then
			return
		end
		shown = value
		TweenService:Create(back, FADE, {BackgroundTransparency = if value then 0.3 else 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(fill, FADE, {BackgroundTransparency = if value then 0 else 1}):Play()
	end

	local function refresh()
		local stamina = (player:GetAttribute("Stamina") :: number?) or MAX_STAMINA
		local sprinting = player:GetAttribute("Sprinting") == true
		TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(stamina / MAX_STAMINA, 1)}):Play()
		hideToken += 1
		if sprinting or stamina < MAX_STAMINA then
			setShown(true)
		else
			local token = hideToken
			task.delay(2, function()

				end
			end)
		end
	end
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Stamina"):Connect(refresh)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Sprinting"):Connect(refresh)

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
		if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
			sprintEvent:FireServer(true)
		end
	end)

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
```

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
```

```lua
	{id = "TalkElder", text = "Talk to the village elder"},
	{id = "ReachTower", text = "Reach the watch tower"},

	local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
	local getSteps = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	getSteps.Name = "GetObjectives"
	getSteps.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	getSteps.OnServerInvoke = function(_player: Player): {Step}
		return STEPS
	end

	local function tryComplete(player: Player, index: number)
		local step = STEPS[index]
		if player:GetAttribute("Obj_" .. step.id) == true then
			return
		end
		for earlier = 1, index - 1 do
			if player:GetAttribute("Obj_" .. STEPS[earlier].id) ~= true then
				return
			end
		end
		player:SetAttribute("Obj_" .. step.id, true)
	end

			part.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
				local player = if hit.Parent then Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) else nil

				end

	end

		for _, step in STEPS do
			player:SetAttribute("Obj_" .. step.id, false)
		end
	end)
```

**Plan**
- One dual-context source: the server owns a 20-slot inventory per player, with a catalog of valid items and a 64-item stack limit.
- The server's `AddItem` function (also exposed through a BindableFunction in ServerStorage) fills existing stacks first, then empty slots, and returns any leftover; every change pushes a snapshot to the owner.
- The client only displays snapshots in a grid and has no way to modify anything.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/GridInventory). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript at StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GridInventoryClient (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local SLOT_COUNT = 20
local MAX_STACK = 64
type Slot = {item: string, count: number}

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local CATALOG: {[string]: boolean} = {Wood = true, Stone = true, Iron = true, Apple = true}

	local updateEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	updateEvent.Name = "InventoryUpdate"
	local getFunction = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	getFunction.Name = "GetInventory"
	updateEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	getFunction.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

	local inventories: {[Player]: {Slot}} = {}

	local function push(player: Player)
		local inventory = inventories[player]
		if inventory then
			updateEvent:FireClient(player, inventory)
		end
	end

	local function addItem(player: Player, item: string, amount: number): number
		local inventory = inventories[player]
		if not inventory or not CATALOG[item] or amount < 1 or amount % 1 ~= 0 then
			return amount
		end
		local remaining = amount
		for _, slot in inventory do
			if slot.item == item and slot.count < MAX_STACK then
				local moved = math.min(MAX_STACK - slot.count, remaining)
				slot.count += moved
				remaining -= moved
			end
		end
		for _, slot in inventory do
			if remaining <= 0 then
				break
			end
			if slot.item == "" then
				local moved = math.min(MAX_STACK, remaining)
				slot.item, slot.count = item, moved
				remaining -= moved
			end
		end
		push(player)
		return remaining
	end

	local adder = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	adder.Name = "InventoryAddItem"
	adder.OnInvoke = addItem
	adder.Parent = ServerStorage

	getFunction.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player): {Slot}
		return inventories[player] or {}
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local inventory: {Slot} = {}
		for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
			inventory[i] = {item = "", count = 0}
		end
		inventories[player] = inventory
		addItem(player, "Wood", 150)
		addItem(player, "Stone", 70)
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		inventories[player] = nil
	end)
else
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local updateEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("InventoryUpdate") :: RemoteEvent
	local getFunction = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GetInventory") :: RemoteFunction

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "InventoryGui"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5 * 76 + 20, 4 * 76 + 20)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 31, 42)
	panel.Parent = gui
	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	grid.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70)
	grid.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
	grid.Parent = panel
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingTop, padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.Parent = panel

	local labels: {TextLabel} = {}
	for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 66)
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.TextSize = 14
		label.LayoutOrder = i
		label.Parent = panel
		labels[i] = label
	end

	local function render(snapshot: {Slot})
		for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
			local slot = snapshot[i]
			labels[i].Text = if slot and slot.item ~= "" then string.format("%s\nx%d", slot.item, slot.count) else ""
		end
	end

	updateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(snapshot: unknown)
		if type(snapshot) == "table" then
			render(snapshot :: {Slot})
		end
	end)
	render(getFunction:InvokeServer())
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end
```

```lua
	updateEvent.Name = "InventorySnapshot"

	updateEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

			inventory[i] = {item = "", count = 0}
		end

		inventory[2] = {item = "Wood", count = 30}
		inventory[3] = {item = "Stone", count = 12}
		inventory[4] = {item = "Apple", count = 5}

			updateEvent:FireClient(player, inventory)
		end)

		inventories[player], lastMove[player] = nil, nil

		local inventory = inventories[player]
		if not inventory or type(from) ~= "number" or type(to) ~= "number" then

			target.count += moved
			source.count -= moved
			if source.count <= 0 then

			end
		else
			source.item, target.item = target.item, source.item
			source.count, target.count = target.count, source.count
		end

	end)

	panel.Parent = gui
	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	grid.CellSize, grid.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
	grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	grid.Parent = panel
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingTop, padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.Parent = panel
	local ghost = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	ghost.Size, ghost.AnchorPoint = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	ghost.BackgroundColor3, ghost.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 255), 0.3
	ghost.TextColor3, ghost.Font, ghost.TextSize = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 14
	ghost.Visible, ghost.ZIndex = false, 10
	ghost.Parent = gui
	local slotFrames: {TextButton} = {}
	local snapshot: {Slot} = {}
	local dragFrom: number? = nil
	local function render()
		for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
			local slot = snapshot[i]
			slotFrames[i].Text = if slot and slot.item ~= "" then string.format("%s\nx%d", slot.item, slot.count) else ""
		end
	end
	local function slotAt(position: Vector2): number?
		for i, frame in slotFrames do
			local topLeft, size = frame.AbsolutePosition, frame.AbsoluteSize
			if position.X >= topLeft.X and position.X <= topLeft.X + size.X and position.Y >= topLeft.Y and position.Y <= topLeft.Y + size.Y then
				return i
			end

		return nil
	end
	for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.AutoButtonColor, button.LayoutOrder = false, i
		button.BackgroundColor3, button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 66), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		button.Font, button.TextSize = Enum.Font.GothamBold, 14
		button.Parent = panel

		button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			local slot = snapshot[i]

		if type(data) == "table" then

	end)
```

```lua
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local SLOTS = {"Head", "Body", "Weapon"}
type ItemDef = {slot: string, health: number, speed: number, damage: number}
local ITEMS: {[string]: ItemDef} = {

	SteelAxe = {slot = "Weapon", health = 0, speed = -1, damage = 25},
}
local BASE_HEALTH, BASE_SPEED = 100, 16

	local equipFunction = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	equipFunction.Name = "EquipItem"
	local stateFunction = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	stateFunction.Name = "GetEquipState"
	equipFunction.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	stateFunction.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

	local owned: {[Player]: {string}} = {}

		if not loadout or not humanoid then
			return
		end
		local health, speed, damage = BASE_HEALTH, BASE_SPEED, 0
		for _, slot in SLOTS do
			local def = ITEMS[loadout[slot]]
			if def then
				health += def.health
				speed += def.speed
				damage += def.damage
			end
		end
		local ratio = humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1)
		humanoid.MaxHealth = health
		humanoid.Health = math.clamp(health * ratio, 1, health)
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
		player:SetAttribute("BonusDamage", damage)
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		loadouts[player] = {Head = "", Body = "", Weapon = ""}
		owned[player] = {"IronHelm", "SwiftHood", "LeatherArmor", "PlateArmor", "IronSword", "SteelAxe"}
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

			return false, loadout
		end
		lastCall[player] = os.clock()

			local def = ITEMS[itemId]
			if not def or def.slot ~= slot or not table.find(owned[player], itemId) then
				return false, loadout
			end
		end
		loadout[slot] = itemId

		return true, loadout
	end
else

	local equipFunction = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EquipItem") :: RemoteFunction
	local stateFunction = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GetEquipState") :: RemoteFunction
	local loadout, ownedItems = stateFunction:InvokeServer()

	statsLabel.Font, statsLabel.TextSize, statsLabel.TextWrapped = Enum.Font.GothamBold, 14, true
	statsLabel.Parent = panel

	local buttons: {[string]: TextButton} = {}
	local function refresh()
		for slot, button in buttons do
			local item = loadout[slot]
			button.Text = slot .. ": " .. (if item and item ~= "" then item else "Empty")
		end
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hp = if humanoid then humanoid.MaxHealth else 0
		local speed = if humanoid then humanoid.WalkSpeed else 0
		statsLabel.Text = string.format("HP %d  Speed %d  Bonus dmg %d", hp, speed, (player:GetAttribute("BonusDamage") :: number?) or 0)
	end

	for index, slot in SLOTS do
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Position, button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10 + (index - 1) * 50), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42)
		button.BackgroundColor3, button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 56, 76), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		button.Font, button.TextSize = Enum.Font.GothamBold, 16
		button.Parent = panel
		buttons[slot] = button
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			local options: {string} = {""}
			for _, itemId in ownedItems do
				if ITEMS[itemId].slot == slot then
					table.insert(options, itemId)
				end
			end
			local position = table.find(options, loadout[slot]) or 1
			local ok, newLoadout = equipFunction:InvokeServer(slot, options[position % #options + 1])
			if ok then
				loadout = newLoadout
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
			refresh()
		end)
	end
	refresh()
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BonusDamage"):Connect(refresh)
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end
```

The server owns the stat table and the loadout: the equip call must name a real slot and an item that belongs in that slot and is owned, and only then are health, walk speed and the BonusDamage attribute recalculated from the base values. Because stats are always rebuilt from the loadout, equipping, swapping and respawning can never stack bonuses twice. The client panel simply asks for the next owned item in each slot and shows whatever the server confirms.

```lua
	inventories[player] = inventories[player] or {}
end

local function giveItem(player: Player, item: string, amount: number)
	local inventory = inventories[player]
	if not inventory then
		return
	end
	inventory[item] = (inventory[item] or 0) + amount
	player:SetAttribute("Inv_" .. item, inventory[item])

local function hookLoot(part: Instance)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	part.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		if part:GetAttribute("Taken") == true or not part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			return
		end
		local player = if hit.Parent then Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) else nil
		if not player or not inventories[player] then
			return
		end
		local item, amount = part:GetAttribute("ItemName"), part:GetAttribute("Amount")
		if type(item) ~= "string" or not CATALOG[item] or type(amount) ~= "number" then
			return
		end
		if amount < 1 or amount > MAX_AMOUNT or amount % 1 ~= 0 then
			return
		end
		part:SetAttribute("Taken", true)
		giveItem(player, item, amount)
		part:Destroy()
	end)
end

	if not CATALOG[item] or amount < 1 or amount > MAX_AMOUNT or amount % 1 ~= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Loot_" .. item
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
	part.Color = CATALOG[item]
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Position = position
	part:SetAttribute("ItemName", item)
	part:SetAttribute("Amount", amount)
	part:SetAttribute("Taken", false)
	CollectionService:AddTag(part, LOOT_TAG)
	part.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(part, DESPAWN_SECONDS)
	return part
end

end)
```

**Plan**
- A server Script loads each player's inventory from a DataStore with retries and refuses to save over data if the load failed.
- Inventory lives in a server table mirrored to `Inv_<item>` attributes; a BindableFunction `InventoryAddItem` lets other server scripts add items.
- Saves use UpdateAsync with retries on leave, every 2 minutes, and for all players in `BindToClose`.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/InventorySave)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerInventory_v1")
local MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
local AUTOSAVE_SECONDS = 120
local MAX_PER_ITEM = 100000
local ITEM_NAMES: {[string]: boolean} = {Wood = true, Stone = true, Iron = true, Gold = true, Pickaxe = true}

type Inventory = {[string]: number}
local inventories: {[Player]: Inventory} = {}
local loaded: {[Player]: boolean} = {}

local function retry(fn: () -> any): (boolean, any)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_ATTEMPTS do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(string.format("[InventorySave] attempt %d failed: %s", attempt, tostring(result)))
		task.wait(attempt * 1.5)
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function sanitize(raw: any): Inventory
	local clean: Inventory = {}
	if type(raw) == "table" then
		for name, count in raw do
			if type(name) == "string" and ITEM_NAMES[name] and type(count) == "number" and count > 0 then
				clean[name] = math.min(math.floor(count), MAX_PER_ITEM)
			end
		end
	end
	return clean
end

local function publish(player: Player, inventory: Inventory)
	for name in ITEM_NAMES do
		player:SetAttribute("Inv_" .. name, inventory[name] or 0)
	end
end

local function save(player: Player)
	local inventory = inventories[player]
	if not inventory or not loaded[player] then
		return
	end
	local snapshot = table.clone(inventory)
	local ok = retry(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync(tostring(player.UserId), function(_old: any)
			return snapshot
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[InventorySave] could not save " .. player.Name)
	end
end

local function load(player: Player)
	local inventory: Inventory = {}
	inventories[player] = inventory
	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId))
	end)
	if not ok then
		player:Kick("Your data could not be loaded. Please rejoin to protect your inventory.")
		return
	end
	for name, count in sanitize(data) do
		inventory[name] = count
	end
	loaded[player] = true
	publish(player, inventory)
end

local adder = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
adder.Name = "InventoryAddItem"
adder.OnInvoke = function(player: Player, item: string, amount: number): boolean
	local inventory = inventories[player]
	if not inventory or not loaded[player] or not ITEM_NAMES[item] or amount < 1 or amount % 1 ~= 0 then
		return false
	end
	inventory[item] = math.min((inventory[item] or 0) + amount, MAX_PER_ITEM)
	publish(player, inventory)
	return true
end
adder.Parent = ServerStorage

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(load)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(load, player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	save(player)
	inventories[player], loaded[player] = nil, nil
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			task.spawn(save, player)
		end
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		task.wait(1)
	end
	local pending = 0
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		pending += 1
		task.spawn(function()
			save(player)
			pending -= 1
		end)
	end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
end)
```

On join the inventory is read with up to five retries and cleaned so only known items with sane counts are accepted; if the read fails the player is kicked rather than allowed to play and overwrite their real save. Saves use UpdateAsync with the same retry helper on leave, every two minutes and for every player at shutdown, and the `loaded` flag blocks any save for a player whose data never loaded.

- `ProcessReceipt` grants 500 coins for the product inside a single `UpdateAsync` call that checks the PurchaseId list first, so a purchase can never be granted twice and the grant and the receipt record are saved together.
- It returns `PurchaseGranted` only after that save succeeds; any failure returns `NotProcessedYet` so Roblox retries.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/CoinProduct)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local COIN_PRODUCT_ID = 1234567890 -- CONFIGURE: your developer product id
local COIN_AMOUNT = 500
local MAX_RECEIPTS = 200
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CoinData_v1")

type Data = {coins: number, receipts: {string}}

local function retry(fn: () -> any): (boolean, any)
	for attempt = 1, 5 do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		task.wait(attempt)
	end
	return false, nil
end

local loaded: {[Player]: boolean} = {}

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Parent = stats
	stats.Parent = player

	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok then
		coins.Value = if type(data) == "table" and type((data :: any).coins) == "number" then (data :: any).coins else 0
		loaded[player] = true
	else
		player:Kick("Could not load your data. Please rejoin.")
	end
end)

local function saveCoins(player: Player)
	local coins = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not loaded[player] or not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end
	local value = coins.Value
	retry(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old: any)
			local data: Data = if type(old) == "table" then old else {coins = 0, receipts = {}}
			data.coins = value
			return data
		end)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	saveCoins(player)
	loaded[player] = nil
end)

MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(info: {[string]: any}): Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(info.PlayerId)
	if not player or not loaded[player] then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if info.ProductId ~= COIN_PRODUCT_ID then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local purchaseId = tostring(info.PurchaseId)
	local alreadyGranted = false
	local ok = retry(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. info.PlayerId, function(old: any)
			local data: Data = if type(old) == "table" then old else {coins = 0, receipts = {}}
			data.receipts = data.receipts or {}
			if table.find(data.receipts, purchaseId) then
				alreadyGranted = true
				return nil
			end
			data.coins = (data.coins or 0) + COIN_AMOUNT
			table.insert(data.receipts, purchaseId)
			while #data.receipts > MAX_RECEIPTS do
				table.remove(data.receipts, 1)
			end
			return data
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	if not alreadyGranted then
		local coins = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		if coins and coins:IsA("IntValue") then
			coins.Value += COIN_AMOUNT
		end
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end
```

The PurchaseId check and the coin grant happen inside one UpdateAsync transaction, so Roblox retrying a receipt after a crash or a rejoin finds the id already recorded and does not pay twice. `PurchaseGranted` is returned only after the save succeeded, and any DataStore failure or missing player returns `NotProcessedYet`, which makes Roblox ask again later. Set `COIN_PRODUCT_ID` to your product.

```lua
-- Script (ServerScriptService/Trading). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript at StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/TradingClient (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ITEMS = {"Wood", "Stone", "Gold"}

	local actionEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	actionEvent.Name = "TradeAction"
	local updateEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	updateEvent.Name = "TradeUpdate"
	actionEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	updateEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	type Trade = {a: Player, b: Player, offers: {[Player]: {[string]: number}}, confirmed: {[Player]: boolean}}
	local inventories: {[Player]: {[string]: number}} = {}
	local tradeOf: {[Player]: Trade} = {}
	local pending: {[Player]: Player} = {}
	local lastAction: {[Player]: number} = {}
	local function send(trade: Trade, closed: string?)
		for _, p in {trade.a, trade.b} do
			local o = if p == trade.a then trade.b else trade.a
			updateEvent:FireClient(p, {partner = o.Name, mine = trade.offers[p], theirs = trade.offers[o],
				myOk = trade.confirmed[p] == true, theirOk = trade.confirmed[o] == true, closed = closed})
		end
	end
	local function close(trade: Trade, message: string)
		send(trade, message)
		tradeOf[trade.a], tradeOf[trade.b] = nil, nil
	end
	local function complete(trade: Trade)
		for _, p in {trade.a, trade.b} do
			for item, amount in trade.offers[p] do
				if (inventories[p][item] or 0) < amount then return close(trade, "Trade failed: items missing") end
			end
		end
		for _, p in {trade.a, trade.b} do
			local other = if p == trade.a then trade.b else trade.a
			for item, amount in trade.offers[p] do
				inventories[p][item] -= amount
				inventories[other][item] = (inventories[other][item] or 0) + amount
			end
		end
		close(trade, "Trade complete!")
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player) inventories[player] = {Wood = 20, Stone = 20, Gold = 5} end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		if tradeOf[player] then close(tradeOf[player], "Trade cancelled: player left") end
		inventories[player], pending[player], lastAction[player] = nil, nil, nil
	end)
	actionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, action: unknown, arg1: unknown, arg2: unknown)
		if type(action) ~= "string" or not inventories[player] or os.clock() - (lastAction[player] or 0) < 0.15 then
			return
		end
		lastAction[player] = os.clock()
		local trade = tradeOf[player]
		if action == "request" and type(arg1) == "number" and not trade then
			local target = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(arg1)
			if target and target ~= player and inventories[target] and not tradeOf[target] then
				pending[target] = player
				updateEvent:FireClient(target, {request = player.Name})
			end
		elseif action == "accept" and not trade then
			local requester = pending[player]
			pending[player] = nil
			if requester and inventories[requester] and not tradeOf[requester] then
				local created: Trade = {a = requester, b = player, offers = {[requester] = {}, [player] = {}}, confirmed = {}}
				tradeOf[requester], tradeOf[player] = created, created
				send(created, nil)
			end
		elseif trade and action == "cancel" then
			close(trade, "Trade cancelled")
		elseif trade and action == "offer" and type(arg1) == "string" and type(arg2) == "number" then
			if table.find(ITEMS, arg1) and arg2 % 1 == 0 and arg2 >= 0 and arg2 <= (inventories[player][arg1] or 0) then
				trade.offers[player][arg1] = if arg2 > 0 then arg2 else nil
				trade.confirmed = {}
				send(trade, nil)
			end
		elseif trade and action == "confirm" then
			trade.confirmed[player] = true
			if trade.confirmed[trade.a] and trade.confirmed[trade.b] then
				complete(trade)
			else
				send(trade, nil)
			end
		end
	end)
```

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/IslandGenerator)
local Terrain = workspace.Terrain
local CELL = 4
local GRID = 72
local RADIUS = 120
local PEAK = 70
local DEPTH = 24
local SEED = 421
local half = GRID * CELL / 2

local function heightAt(x: number, z: number): number
	local dist = math.sqrt(x * x + z * z) / RADIUS
	local shape = 1 - dist * dist
	local cone = math.max(0, 1 - dist * 2.2)
	local rough = math.noise(x / 40, z / 40, SEED) * 5 * math.max(0, shape)
	local top = shape * 20 - 6 + cone ^ 1.5 * PEAK + rough
	return math.max(top, -DEPTH + 2 * CELL)
end

local function surfaceMaterial(top: number): Enum.Material
	if top < 5 then
		return Enum.Material.Sand
	elseif top > 38 then
		return Enum.Material.Rock
	end
	return Enum.Material.Grass
end

local function buildColumn(x: number, z: number)
	local top = heightAt(x, z)
	local coreTop = top - CELL
	local core = if top < 6 then Enum.Material.Sand else Enum.Material.Rock
	Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(x, (coreTop - DEPTH) / 2, z), Vector3.new(CELL, coreTop + DEPTH, CELL), core)
	Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(x, top - CELL / 2, z), Vector3.new(CELL, CELL, CELL), surfaceMaterial(top))
end

Terrain:Clear()
Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(0, -DEPTH / 2, 0), Vector3.new(GRID * CELL, DEPTH, GRID * CELL), Enum.Material.Water)
for i = 0, GRID - 1 do
	for j = 0, GRID - 1 do
		buildColumn(-half + i * CELL + CELL / 2, -half + j * CELL + CELL / 2)
	end
	task.wait()
end

local beachX = RADIUS * 0.8
local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(beachX, 300, 0), Vector3.new(0, -600, 0))
local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
spawn.Anchored = true
spawn.Neutral = true
```

```lua
grid[1][1].visited = true
while #stack > 0 do
	local cur = stack[#stack]
	local options = {}
	for _, d in DIRS do
		local row = grid[cur.X + d.dx]
		local cell = if row then row[cur.Y + d.dy] else nil
		if cell and not cell.visited then
			table.insert(options, d)
		end
	end
	if #options == 0 then
		table.remove(stack)
	else
		local d = options[rng:NextInteger(1, #options)]
		local nx, ny = cur.X + d.dx, cur.Y + d.dy
		grid[cur.X][cur.Y].walls[d.name] = false
		grid[nx][ny].walls[d.opposite] = false
		grid[nx][ny].visited = true
		table.insert(stack, Vector2.new(nx, ny))
	end
end

grid[N][N].walls.S = false

local wallColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 120, 100)
for x = 1, N do

		if w.W then makePart(vert, Vector3.new(cx - CELL / 2, HEIGHT / 2, cz), wallColor) end
```

The DFS keeps a stack of cells: it looks at unvisited neighbours, removes the wall between the current cell and a random one, and pushes it; with no free neighbour it pops back. Because every cell is visited exactly once through a spanning tree, the maze has one path between any two cells and never contains a sealed-off area. Building only north and west walls per cell (plus the outer south and east edges) avoids duplicate Parts.

**Plan**
- Place up to 9 random non-overlapping rooms (with a 2-tile gap) on a 60x60 tile map, then connect each new room to its nearest earlier room with an L-shaped corridor, recording the links.
- A breadth-first search over those links from room 1 (spawn) finds the room with the most hops, which becomes the boss room.
- Rooms and corridors are floor Parts; the spawn room is green with a SpawnLocation, the boss room is red with a neon altar.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/DungeonGenerator)
local TILE = 8
local MAP = 60
local ROOM_COUNT = 9
local rng = Random.new()

type Room = { x: number, z: number, w: number, h: number, cx: number, cz: number, links: { number }, floor: Part }
local rooms: { Room } = {}
local dungeon = Instance.new("Model")
dungeon.Name = "Dungeon"

local function makeFloor(minX: number, minZ: number, sizeX: number, sizeZ: number, y: number, color: Color3): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Size = Vector3.new(sizeX * TILE, 1, sizeZ * TILE)
	p.Position = Vector3.new((minX + sizeX / 2) * TILE, y, (minZ + sizeZ / 2) * TILE)
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone
	p.Parent = dungeon
	return p
end

local attempts = 0
while #rooms < ROOM_COUNT and attempts < 500 do
	attempts += 1
	local w, h = rng:NextInteger(5, 10), rng:NextInteger(5, 10)
	local x, z = rng:NextInteger(1, MAP - w - 1), rng:NextInteger(1, MAP - h - 1)
	local overlaps = false
	for _, r in rooms do
		if x < r.x + r.w + 2 and x + w + 2 > r.x and z < r.z + r.h + 2 and z + h + 2 > r.z then
			overlaps = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not overlaps then
		local floor = makeFloor(x, z, w, h, 0, Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120))
		table.insert(rooms, { x = x, z = z, w = w, h = h, cx = x + w // 2, cz = z + h // 2, links = {}, floor = floor })
	end
end

local corridorColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 90)
for i = 2, #rooms do
	local a, nearest, best = rooms[i], 1, math.huge
	for j = 1, i - 1 do
		local d = math.abs(a.cx - rooms[j].cx) + math.abs(a.cz - rooms[j].cz)
		if d < best then nearest, best = j, d end
	end
	local b = rooms[nearest]
	table.insert(a.links, nearest)
	table.insert(b.links, i)
	local x1, x2 = math.min(a.cx, b.cx), math.max(a.cx, b.cx)
	local z1, z2 = math.min(a.cz, b.cz), math.max(a.cz, b.cz)
	makeFloor(x1 - 1, a.cz - 1, x2 - x1 + 2, 2, -0.05, corridorColor)
	makeFloor(b.cx - 1, z1 - 1, 2, z2 - z1 + 2, -0.05, corridorColor)
end

local dist: { [number]: number } = { [1] = 0 }
local queue = { 1 }
local head = 1
while head <= #queue do
	local i = queue[head]
	head += 1
	for _, j in rooms[i].links do
		if dist[j] == nil then
			dist[j] = dist[i] + 1
			table.insert(queue, j)
		end
	end
end
local boss = 1
for i, d in dist do
	if d > dist[boss] then boss = i end
end

rooms[1].floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 190, 90)
if boss ~= 1 then
	local bossRoom = rooms[boss]
	bossRoom.floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 40, 40)
	local altar = makeFloor(bossRoom.cx - 1, bossRoom.cz - 1, 2, 2, 1.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60))
	altar.Name = "BossAltar"
	altar.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
end

local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
spawn.Anchored = true
spawn.Neutral = true
spawn.Position = Vector3.new(rooms[1].cx * TILE, 2, rooms[1].cz * TILE)
spawn.Parent = workspace
dungeon.Parent = workspace
```

Rooms are rejected when their padded rectangles overlap, and each new room joins its nearest earlier room, so the whole dungeon is connected. The boss room is the one with the greatest number of room-to-room hops from the spawn room, found by BFS over the recorded links, which means the player really has to cross the dungeon to reach it. Corridor floors sit 0.05 studs lower than rooms so they never z-fight where they overlap.

```lua

-- Script (ServerScriptService/ScatterScenery)
local Terrain = workspace.Terrain

local AREA = 280
local MIN_GAP = 7
local MAX_TRIES = 3000
local rng = Random.new()

local params = RaycastParams.new()

	model.Name = "Tree"

	leaves.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = trunk
	model.Parent = folder
end

	local rock = newPart(s, Enum.PartType.Block, Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 115), Enum.Material.Slate)
	local tilt = CFrame.Angles(rng:NextNumber(-0.3, 0.3), rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2), rng:NextNumber(-0.3, 0.3))
	rock.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, s.Y * 0.3, 0)) * tilt

	rock.Parent = folder
end

local count, tries = 0, 0
while count < COUNT and tries < MAX_TRIES do
	tries += 1
	local x = rng:NextNumber(-AREA / 2, AREA / 2)
	local z = rng:NextNumber(-AREA / 2, AREA / 2)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 500, z), Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), params)
	if hit and hit.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water and hit.Normal.Y > 0.75 and hit.Position.Y > 1.5 and farEnough(hit.Position) then
		if hit.Material == Enum.Material.Grass and rng:NextNumber() < 0.7 then
			makeTree(hit.Position)
		else
			makeRock(hit.Position)

	if tries % 25 == 0 then

folder.Parent = workspace
print(("Placed %d objects in %d tries"):format(count, tries))
```

Rays are limited to Terrain and told not to skip water, so a ray over a lake returns a Water hit that the script rejects, instead of landing on the seabed. The hit position is the real ground point, so trunks and rocks are lowered slightly into the slope to avoid floating edges. The 7-stud spacing check, slope check and try limit keep the loop finite even if the terrain is mostly ocean.

**Plan**
- A LocalScript derives the time from `workspace:GetServerTimeNow()`, so every client shows the same time with no remote traffic: 24 in-game hours span 600 real seconds.
- Each frame it sets `Lighting.ClockTime` and blends ambient, outdoor ambient, brightness and fog between night and day colours using the sun's height.
- A warm tint appears around sunrise and sunset, and an `IsNight` attribute on Lighting tells other local scripts when it changes.

```lua
--!strict
-- LocalScript (StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/DayNightCycle)
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DAY_LENGTH = 600
local START_CLOCK = 8

local NIGHT = {
	ambient = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 40),
	outdoor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 64),
	fog = Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 32),
	brightness = 0.15,
}
local DAY = {
	ambient = Color3.fromRGB(110, 115, 125),
	outdoor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 175),
	fog = Color3.fromRGB(190, 205, 225),
	brightness = 2.2,
}
local SUNSET_TINT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 60)
local NO_TINT = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)

local function sunHeight(clock: number): number
	return math.sin((clock - 6) / 12 * math.pi)
end

local function clockNow(): number
	return (START_CLOCK + workspace:GetServerTimeNow() * 24 / DAY_LENGTH) % 24
end

local function apply(clock: number)
	local sun = sunHeight(clock)
	local day = math.clamp(sun * 3, 0, 1)
	local twilight = math.clamp(1 - math.abs(sun) * 4, 0, 1)

	Lighting.ClockTime = clock
	Lighting.Ambient = NIGHT.ambient:Lerp(DAY.ambient, day)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = NIGHT.outdoor:Lerp(DAY.outdoor, day)
	Lighting.FogColor = NIGHT.fog:Lerp(DAY.fog, day)
	Lighting.Brightness = NIGHT.brightness + (DAY.brightness - NIGHT.brightness) * day
	Lighting.ColorShift_Top = NO_TINT:Lerp(SUNSET_TINT, twilight * 0.5)

	local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
	if atmosphere then
		atmosphere.Color = NIGHT.fog:Lerp(DAY.fog, day)
		atmosphere.Density = 0.45 - 0.15 * day
	end

	local isNight = day <= 0
	if Lighting:GetAttribute("IsNight") ~= isNight then
		Lighting:SetAttribute("IsNight", isNight)
	end
end

apply(clockNow())
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	apply(clockNow())
end)
```

`clockNow` maps real seconds to hours (a full 24 hours every 600 seconds, starting at 08:00) and uses server time, so late joiners and every player see the same sky. The sun-height sine is zero at 06:00 and 18:00, so the day factor is clamped to zero all night and rises quickly at dawn; ambient, brightness and fog are simply lerped by that factor, with an orange colour shift added near the horizon.

**Plan**
- Road segments are 40-stud Parts laid along the negative Z axis at index * 40; a few segments carry a deadly obstacle block.
- Every 0.2 s the script finds the furthest-forward and furthest-back player; it spawns segments until the track extends 240 studs beyond the leader and destroys segments more than 80 studs behind the last player.
- The obstacle layout is seeded from the segment index so it is deterministic and cheap.

```lua

-- Script (ServerScriptService/RunnerTrack)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local SEG_LEN = 40
local SEG_WIDTH = 24
local AHEAD = 240
local BEHIND = 80
local TICK = 0.2

local track = Instance.new("Folder")
track.Name = "Track"
track.Parent = workspace

local segments: { [number]: Part } = {}
local nextIndex = 0
local oldest = 0

local function killOnTouch(obstacle: Part)
	local debounce = false
	obstacle.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		if debounce then return end
		local humanoid = if hit.Parent then hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			debounce = true
			humanoid.Health = 0
		end
	end)
end

local function spawnSegment(i: number)
	local rng = Random.new(i)
	local road = Instance.new("Part")
	road.Name = "Segment" .. i
	road.Anchored = true
	road.Size = Vector3.new(SEG_WIDTH, 1, SEG_LEN)
	road.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -i * SEG_LEN)
	road.Material = Enum.Material.Asphalt
	road.Color = if i % 2 == 0 then Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 60) else Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 70)
	if i >= 3 and rng:NextNumber() < 0.6 then
		local obstacle = Instance.new("Part")
		obstacle.Name = "Obstacle"
		obstacle.Anchored = true
		obstacle.Size = Vector3.new(rng:NextInteger(4, 10), 4, 2)
		obstacle.Position = road.Position + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-8, 8), 2.5, rng:NextNumber(-12, 12))
		obstacle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 60, 50)
		obstacle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		killOnTouch(obstacle)
		obstacle.Parent = road
	end
	road.Parent = track
	segments[i] = road
end

local startPad = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
startPad.Anchored = true
startPad.Neutral = true
startPad.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
startPad.Parent = workspace
for _ = 1, 6 do
	spawnSegment(nextIndex)
	nextIndex += 1
end

local elapsed = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed < TICK then return end
	elapsed = 0
	local lead, rear, found = math.huge, -math.huge, false
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local root = if player.Character then player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			found = true
			lead = math.min(lead, root.Position.Z)
			rear = math.max(rear, root.Position.Z)
		end
	end
	if not found then return end
	while -nextIndex * SEG_LEN > lead - AHEAD do
		spawnSegment(nextIndex)
		nextIndex += 1
	end
	while oldest < nextIndex and -oldest * SEG_LEN > rear + BEHIND do
		segments[oldest]:Destroy()
		segments[oldest] = nil
		oldest += 1
	end
end)
```

Players run towards negative Z, so a segment is behind them when its Z is larger than theirs. Generation is driven by the furthest-ahead player and cleanup by the furthest-behind one, which keeps multiplayer runs consistent, and the 0.2 s tick keeps the work tiny. Obstacles are children of their segment, so `Destroy` removes them and their connections together.
